FN-G1J4666-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 128
Committee: Boards, Agencies, and Sponsor: Representative Neil Rafferty
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 128 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Board of Nursing until
October 1, 2029 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or
local funding.
